description: The segments this campaign takes leads from (up to 10), each with the revision someone approved (`approvedRevision`), who approved it, when it last synced and its `state`: `covered` (the segment is still at the approved revision, so contacts who join it become leads), `edited` (the segment changed since; link it again at its new revision to approve it) or `held` (new leads stopped, `heldReason` says why: `list_gate`, `key_bounds`, `approver_lapsed` or `checks_unavailable`; link it again to lift the hold).
name: list_campaign_segments
title: List a campaign's linked segments
